title: Peer profile rule in the SDK
description: Peer profile rule in the SDK.
acceptance: Authority profile is read only from verified metadata
A lower profile than required is rejected unless an audited operator override exists
An undeterminable profile is treated as Basic
findings: Correction: imported plan defined peer as the verifying client and enforced the rule only when metadata is available, which lets an Authority avoid the check by publishing none. Peer is the Authority.
